content.text: Error: BioMCP allows read-only commands only. Allowed families are search/get/helpers/list/version/health/batch/enrich/discover/skill plus MCP-safe study commands (`study list`, `study download --list`, `study top-mutated`, `study query`, `study filter`, `study cohort`, `study survival`, `study compare`, `study co-occurrence`).
